question: the two V4.1 divergences left open by results/abi3/deepseek_v41_rom_join_context_engram.json: (1) ROM vs HBM prefill taps first differing at L24.ffn_norm rows 7-9 at P10; (2) HBM decode vs prefill stepping from 0.99997 to 0.915 at L02.ffn_norm -- what are they, and do the fixes make the cells agree?
method: per-operator probes on runtime.sim (every engine issue of chosen kernels: operands, outputs, PHASE/POSITION_START/CONTEXT_LENGTH, loop iterations), first on the reduced V4.1 v2 model (HBM cluster32 comparator, ROM wafer comparator, ROM array 12-node comparator: minutes per run) at the full model's geometry of window 128, block 8, ratios 2/1; decode step at POSITION_START 9 vs the last row of a prefill over the same 10 tokens; then the full model at P10/P12

root_causes_and_fixes.defect: candidate pool (layer 20 BLOCK_MAX -> block-select INDEX_TOPK -> CANDIDATE_MASK, read by layers 24/28/32/36): the HBM lane did not set RANKS_BLOCKS on the block select, so block IDs were rebased by the context (block 0 at P10 came back as block 10); and in BOTH lanes the engine counted only COMPLETE blocks ((p+1)//8) and relied on CANDIDATE_MASK pinning the PLANE's last block, which at plane capacity (512 HBM, 8192 ROM) is past the context. The release (select_candidate_blocks) pins the block holding each query's newest position at +inf.
root_causes_and_fixes.measured: full-model HBM P10 at HEAD: the pool mask admitted nothing reachable for rows 0-6 and dropped positions 8-9 for rows 8-9; ROM admitted block 0 only; this is the L24 row difference. With the fix: rows 0-7 admit block 0, rows 8-9 blocks 0-1 (all reachable positions, as the release at P10).
root_causes_and_fixes.fix: runtime/sim/engines/route.py (a RANKS_BLOCKS ranking reaches p//block+1 blocks and forces the newest into the selection); compiler/backends/hbm_sram/plan.py sets RANKS_BLOCKS as the ROM lane does

root_causes_and_fixes.defect: decode rebase of a separated-join selection: V4.1's INDEX_TOPK declares in1 (window) absent and a CONCAT joins behind the 128-row window, so the engine had no window to measure and rebased a DECODE selection by zero -- compressed group j became KV row j (a window row). Every decode query on layers 2-39 attended window rows twice and no compressed row.
root_causes_and_fixes.measured: reduced HBM decode at POSITION_START 9, layer 2: select [0..4] (should be [128..132]); decode/prefill L02.ffn_norm cosine 0.998392 -> 0.999989 after the fix
root_causes_and_fixes.fix: compiler.ir.v3.lowering.separated_join_window states the join's window width above bit 16 of aux_id_1 (runtime.sim.engines.route.DECODE_REBASE_SHIFT) in both lanes; zero keeps every other descriptor

root_causes_and_fixes.defect: decode compressed RoPE: both lanes rotate a group a decode step completes at p+1-ratio only for a GATHER spelled "compressed" (V4); V4.1 states only position_stride, so compressed KV rows and index keys completed in decode on layers 2/8/14 were rotated at p
root_causes_and_fixes.measured: reduced HBM decode at POSITION_START 9: the newest compressed KV row differed from prefill's by up to 1.81; after the fix all 80 decode taps are bit-identical to prefill
root_causes_and_fixes.fix: compiler.ir.v3.lowering.compressed_rope_gather (either spelling) in the HBM lowering, ROM lowering and ROM checker

root_causes_and_fixes.defect: ROM only, exposed by the rebase fix: ATTENTION.SPARSE consumes the phase-split KV join but also binds the span-led fused-KV plane, so its context loop was opened on the span and the ratio-2 decode KV view resolved to the 128-row window alone; the reduced ROM wafer decode trapped at "selects KV row 131, outside the 128 valid rows"
root_causes_and_fixes.fix: compiler/backends/rom/common/program.py opens the CONTEXT_LENGTH loop for a phase-split consumer with a context-bound phase extent in the plane branch too
